deviation: The draft meets the USD 5M per-claim minimum and adds cyber cover and a post-term tail, which favour Arcadia. But it drops the required commercial general liability cover, so Helix could satisfy it with professional and cyber policies alone and leave third-party bodily injury and property damage uninsured.
suggested_text: 11.1 Throughout the term and for so long thereafter as claims may reasonably arise, Helix shall maintain, with reputable insurers, professional indemnity insurance, commercial general liability insurance and cyber liability insurance, each of at least USD 5,000,000 per claim, covering its liabilities under this Agreement. 11.2 Helix shall provide certificates of insurance upon Arcadia's request.
